expectations.text: Recommends co-locating a type with the module that owns it as the default (not a central types.ts)
expectations.evidence: 'Move it next to that code. This is most of your file.' Title: 'Move most types next to the code that owns them.'

expectations.text: Reframes 'single source of truth' as defined-once, not all-in-one-file
expectations.evidence: 'Single source of truth means each type is defined once... It does not mean every definition lives in the same physical file.'

expectations.text: Keeps genuinely shared/global types in a shared or feature-level file (does NOT advise one-type-per-file scattering)
expectations.evidence: Feature-folder types.ts for shared, central for global primitives; 'don't overcorrect into zero shared types either.'

expectations.text: Grounds it in the agent skipping the cross-file lookup (the central types file is the sibling it won't open)
expectations.evidence: 'AI tools are weirdly reluctant to open adjacent files... the agent reliably does the first and forgets the second.'
